cond_0001.intro: The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings

cond_0007.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. The role involves performing laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed or certified, and managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts. This may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training of new employees, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing and reviewing procedures, and other assigned tasks. Work primarily involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens, requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included in the duties; additional hours may also be required. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures and maintains quality control practices.
cond_0007.responsibilities:
Assist with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Manage quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, and interviewing applicants; provide input for staff performance; oversee training and competency evaluations.
Assist laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Read, examine, and interpret complex test results; serve as a technical resource for complex tests and procedures.
Manage instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Lead quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assist with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Perform assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of assigned equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical activities.
Perform all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures and competency standards.
Participate in proficiency testing, adhering to federal and state regulations and institutional policies.
Perform post-analytical activities, including reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provide technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provide orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
Act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Document orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provide guidance to technical and support staff; resolve customer service issues within established guidelines; provide support education to clinical staff as requested.
Facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follow appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Adhere to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Complete required initial and refresher training for handling and transporting hazardous waste, including proper selection, use, and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participate in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Perform various support activities to facilitate operation of the assigned department or work area.
Participate in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assist in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0007.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT)
Technical skills related to laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Clear written and verbal communication in English with patients, staff, and customers of varied backgrounds
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents
Adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protection of patient information confidentiality at all times
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience

Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision

cond_0037.intro: The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0037.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0037.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings

Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0055.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0055.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings

cond_0113.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all. Most people become stronger in this kind of laboratory work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0113.responsibilities:

Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned

Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students

cond_0163.intro: The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0163.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0163.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings

cond_0223.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. The role involves performing laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed or certified, and managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts. This may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training of new employees, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing and reviewing procedures, and other assigned tasks. Work primarily involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens, requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included in the duties; additional hours may also be required. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures and maintains quality control practices.
cond_0223.responsibilities:
Assist with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Manage quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, and interviewing applicants; provide input for staff performance; oversee training and competency evaluations.
Assist laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Read, examine, and interpret complex test results; serve as a technical resource for complex tests and procedures.
Manage instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Lead quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assist with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Perform assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of assigned equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical activities.
Perform all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures and competency standards.
Participate in proficiency testing, adhering to federal and state regulations and institutional policies.
Perform post-analytical activities, including reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provide technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provide orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
Act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Document orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provide guidance to technical and support staff; resolve customer service issues within established guidelines; provide support education to clinical staff as requested.
Facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follow appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Adhere to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Complete required initial and refresher training for handling and transporting hazardous waste, including proper selection, use, and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participate in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Perform various support activities to facilitate operation of the assigned department or work area.
Participate in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assist in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Perform other duties as assigned.

cond_0271.intro: The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0271.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings

This may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training of new employees, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing and reviewing procedures, and other assigned tasks. Work primarily involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens, requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included in the duties; additional hours may also be required. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures and maintains quality control practices.
cond_0277.responsibilities:
Assist with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Manage quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, and interviewing applicants; provide input for staff performance; oversee training and competency evaluations.
Assist laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Read, examine, and interpret complex test results; serve as a technical resource for complex tests and procedures.
Manage instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Lead quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assist with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Perform assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of assigned equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical activities.
Perform all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures and competency standards.
Participate in proficiency testing, adhering to federal and state regulations and institutional policies.
Perform post-analytical activities, including reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provide technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provide orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
Act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Document orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provide guidance to technical and support staff; resolve customer service issues within established guidelines; provide support education to clinical staff as requested.
Facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follow appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Adhere to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Complete required initial and refresher training for handling and transporting hazardous waste, including proper selection, use, and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participate in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Perform various support activities to facilitate operation of the assigned department or work area.
Participate in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assist in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0277.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT)
Technical skills related to laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Clear written and verbal communication in English with patients, staff, and customers of varied backgrounds
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents
Adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protection of patient information confidentiality at all times
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience

It involves coordinating selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training of new employees, problem solving for customers and coworkers, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other assigned tasks. Work involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens, generally requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed area(s). Depending on department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included; additional hours may also be required. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures, maintains quality control practices, and supports outstanding customer service while maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0360.responsibilities:
Coordinate with lab management on staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Work with leadership on quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, staff performance input, and training and competency evaluations.
Support laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Read, examine, and interpret complex test results. Serve as a shared resource and help address complex tests/procedures.
Coordinate instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Work with the team on quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assist with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Carry out assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking; specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities.
Perform all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.
Participate in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as institutional policies.
Carry out post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Share technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Help provide orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Document orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provide guidance to technical and support staff, help resolve customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Help facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follow appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrate understanding of and adhere to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participate in, and maintain knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Carry out various support activities to help with the operation of assigned department or work area.
Participate in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assist with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Help with documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports.
May cover Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to help ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0360.requirements:
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned.
Follows and ensures adherence of staff to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times.
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities.
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings.
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner.
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents.
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field.
Two years of technical experience in a core lab.
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab required.
Leadership experience a plus.
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT.
cond_0360.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

cond_0379.intro: The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0379.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0379.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings

cond_0439.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. The role involves performing laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed or certified, and managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts. This may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training of new employees, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing and reviewing procedures, and other assigned tasks. Work primarily involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens, requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included in the duties; additional hours may also be required. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures and maintains quality control practices.
cond_0439.responsibilities:
Assist with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Manage quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, and interviewing applicants; provide input for staff performance; oversee training and competency evaluations.
Assist laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Read, examine, and interpret complex test results; serve as a technical resource for complex tests and procedures.
Manage instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Lead quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assist with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Perform assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of assigned equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical activities.
Perform all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures and competency standards.
Participate in proficiency testing, adhering to federal and state regulations and institutional policies.
Perform post-analytical activities, including reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provide technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provide orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
Act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Document orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provide guidance to technical and support staff; resolve customer service issues within established guidelines; provide support education to clinical staff as requested.
Facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follow appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Adhere to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Complete required initial and refresher training for handling and transporting hazardous waste, including proper selection, use, and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participate in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Perform various support activities to facilitate operation of the assigned department or work area.
Participate in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assist in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0439.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT)
Technical skills related to laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Clear written and verbal communication in English with patients, staff, and customers of varied backgrounds
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents
Adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protection of patient information confidentiality at all times
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience

The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist works alongside the laboratory team to perform various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. This role shares responsibility for managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, problem solving for customers and coworkers, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other assigned tasks. Work involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens, generally requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures and maintains quality control practices. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0495.responsibilities:
Coordinates with staff on schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Supports quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, and assists with training and competency evaluations.
Assists laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a shared resource and helps address complex tests/procedures.
Coordinates instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices with the team.
Supports quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking; specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities.
Works with the team to perform all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as institutional policies.
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Shares technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, helps resolve customer service issues within guidelines, and supports education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Helps facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Performs various support activities to help with the operation of assigned department or work area.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports.
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to help ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0495.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT)
Technical skills related to the laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department or work area
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Ability to communicate effectively in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners, and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents

We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of laboratory testing processes and procedures.
cond_0535.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0535.requirements:
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Strong expertise in Blood Banking and core lab required
Leadership experience a plus
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
